title: Lab template
description: Every lab file in labs/{fundamentals,core,more}/ must contain these sections and callouts.

gotcha_convention.description: Non-schema-enforced authoring rule (guarded by tests/test_lab_content.py): a > ⚠️ **Gotcha** callout is either (a) a single lab-specific mistake, ≤ 4 lines, inline; or (b) a one-line pointer to labs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md#<anchor> for cross-cutting infra/tool errors. Deep multi-step recovery details live only in labs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md.
